Manual:

Auto Run (Treadmill):

Player:

Utilities:

* Server Hop - Enabled
* Destroy GUI - Enabled

UI:

* 3 tabs: Main, Misc, Credits

* Author: galaxy.lua, maintained by Ronix Studios
